Hi,
 Please have look at the below position and let me know your interest
 

 Job Title: Java Developer with RCP (Non-web UI development for a Java RCP solution) 
 Engagement Length: 5 Months 
 Location: Kansas, Missouri 
 

 Skillset Requirements:Must Have: Java skills, Java UI development experience, understanding of Eclipse, RCP/SWT knowledge or experience.
 Like to Have: Maven, Java Certification, good communication skills.Details: Non-web UI development for a Java RCP solution
 ROLE Software Engineer-Java and Web TechnologyThe Software Engineer is assigned to a specific software solution and is responsible for writing code to meet user interface specifications. Responsibilities also include defining user needs, providing input to functional design, testing and troubleshooting.
 Required: Core Java, RCP, SQL development
 Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in IT related field 5+ years of experience with software development Ability to lead and mentor associates Strong communication skills; written and verbal Strong critical thinking and systematic problem solving skills Live or willing to relocate to the Kansas City area
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
